checked_scope: The fixed-own-bundle criterion, monotone pruning rule, and the proportional/two-agent constructions.
checks: For a nonempty residual part, all-good EFX is exactly load-minus-minimum<=own utility; empty parts impose no constraint and a contained zero forces full load<=own utility.

Adding any nonnegative weight weakly increases load-minus-minimum, so pruning above u is sound. State counts ((W+1)(V+2))^(n-1) and m(n-1) transitions yield a fixed-population pseudopolynomial recognizer; clearing rational denominators can be exponential in input bit length.

Descending least-load partition handles every zero and gives actual EFX. If another bundle has two positive items, its smallest positive item and residual both fit the own load, giving EFL. Proportional scaling preserves this, and two-agent cut-and-choose gives the chooser envy-freeness and divider EFX/EFL.
